facts.text: Mr. MacMillan and our new V.P. of Product Development, four hands on one keyboard.
facts.why: MacMillan and Josh play 'Heart and Soul' and 'Chopsticks' on the Walking Piano at FAO Schwarz. It is a floor piano played with the feet, so it is four feet, not four hands.
facts.fix: Mr. MacMillan and our new V.P. of Product Development, four feet on one keyboard.

facts.why: The party scene has caviar and miniature corn cobs, but no source gives the colour or says salmon roe.
No hot dog or cart appears in the transcript or the plot. The dish name claims a scene that is not there, so it becomes a plain dish name.

vibe.verdict: The party menu hits the baby corn and caviar scenes and the paperwork look is neat, though the toy shop is under used.
